subject: Sunrise Systems — vendor onboarding: DPA, SOC 2 report, and subprocessor roster
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@sunrisesystems.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sunrisesystems.com
Date: 2028-06-07T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Sunrise vendor intake — initial docs and PO template

Hi Jonas,

Following our discovery call this morning, procurement asked me to collect the mandatory onboarding artifacts so we can route a PO and complete legal sign-off. Please send the following:

- Fully executed DPA (or DocuSign link)
- Link to your most recent SOC 2 report (or portal access)
- Current subprocessor inventory (CSV preferred)
- Invoicing / remit-to details and any billing contact

I've attached our PO template for your finance team to confirm routing and billing fields (Sunrise_PO_Template.xlsx). We typically need the PO number and remit address on the signed DPA before we create a purchase order.

Can you confirm if you can: 1) eSign the DPA, 2) upload the subprocessor CSV to an SFTP or provide a direct download, and 3) provide an expected lead time for PO issuance once we receive the paperwork?

Thanks — we have a planned go-live for the pilot on 2028-07-02, so moving quickly would be helpful.

Best,
Maya Singh
Procurement Manager
Sunrise Systems

Attachments: Sunrise_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@sunrisesystems.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sunrise vendor intake — initial docs and PO template

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear checklist. Copying Ben (Sales Ops) and Laura (Legal) so we get procurement and PO routing aligned.

Quick status:
- DPA: I've attached the current Redwood_DPA_v3.4.pdf and will send the DocuSign envelope to your procurement inbox by EOD.
- SOC 2: Public report (latest) is here: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/compliance/SOC2-2027-Report.pdf. If you need portal access for the full SOC 2 package, Laura can arrange a temporary viewer link.
- Subprocessors: the roster is available as a CSV; I placed it on our secure SFTP and shared the path below. We'll also provide a static CSV attachment (subprocessors_20280607.csv) for immediate ingestion.
- Invoicing: Redwood invoices should be sent to invoices@redwood.com. Our remit-to is in the attached PO template response section; if Sunrise requires a vendor form, we can complete that and return within 24 hours.

SFTP (read-only): sftp://files.redwood-inference.com/sunrise/subprocessors_20280607.csv
DocuSign envelope (DPA): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF-123456

Proposed mutual action plan (short):
1) 06/07 — DPA sent to Sunrise for signature (DocuSign)
2) 06/08 — Sunrise review & return signed DPA + confirm PO fields
3) 06/09 — Redwood acknowledges PO and confirms invoice remit-to
4) 07/02 — Pilot go-live (depends on PO issuance)

Laura: any expected redline hotspots on v3.4 I should flag to Maya?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.4.pdf (pdf); subprocessors_20280607.csv (csv)
From: Maya Singh <maya@sunrisesystems.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sunrisesystems.com, Mark Pritchard <mark.pritchard@sunrisesystems.com>
Date: 2028-06-08T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sunrise vendor intake — initial docs and PO template

Jonas — received, thank you. A couple of clarifying items from our side:

- We will review the DPA in DocuSign today. If there are redlines, procurement will return them via the DocuSign comment flow and loop legal.
- The SOC 2 link looks good; procurement would like a contact to request time-limited portal access if our security team needs to dig deeper. Please provide a contact.
- Subprocessor CSV: the SFTP path works. Can you confirm the CSV columns include: vendor_name, vendor_role, country, data_processed, last_update?
- PO fields: we require an explicit remit-to address + tax ID on the signed paperwork. If your remit-to is different from the billing email above, we need the legal remit address.

Also, procurement asks whether Redwood publishes a monthly subprocessor snapshot. If so, please note cadence and where Sunrise can pull the latest version.

If all looks clean by EOD we can generate a PO (tentative lead time: 48 business hours for creation + approvals).

Thanks,
Maya

Maya / Sunrise procurement team —

Quick update to close the loop:

1) DPA — Completed. The DocuSign envelope has been signed by Redwood and executed; you should have a final signed PDF in the envelope. If you need a countersigned copy emailed, let me know and I will attach it.
   - DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF-123456

2) Subprocessor roster — The CSV we uploaded includes the columns you requested (vendor_name, vendor_role, country, data_processed, last_update). Redwood publishes a monthly snapshot on the SFTP path; we also push a notification to our vendor portal when the roster changes.
   - SFTP (read-only): sftp://files.redwood-inference.com/sunrise/subprocessors_20280607.csv

3) SOC 2 access — Laura can provision a time-limited viewer link for your security team if you provide the email(s) of the reviewers. Please send names/emails and an estimated window.

4) PO / invoicing — We confirm invoices@redwood.com as the remit-to email and our legal remit address is: Redwood Inference, 580 Market St., Suite 600, San Francisco, CA 94104. Tax ID: 94-3126540. Once Sunrise issues a PO number, route a PDF copy to invoices@redwood.com and cc ben.carter@redwood.com for expedited processing.

Next steps for us: Ben will monitor for the incoming PO and confirm receipt; Laura will stand by for any legal follow-ups. Happy to schedule a 15-minute wrap-up call if Sunrise wants to confirm the PO fields before issuing.

Thanks for the speedy turnaround — we look forward to the pilot.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
